methods.label: Rewrite with a common base
methods.explanation:
Since \(8=2^3\) and \(32=2^5\), rewriting with base \(2\) lets us compare the exponents. The power-of-a-power rule gives
\[
8^x=32
\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
(2^3)^x=2^5
\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
2^{3x}=2^5.
\]
Because \(2>1\), its powers strictly increase as the real exponent increases. Thus equal powers of \(2\) must have equal exponents, so \(3x=5\). Dividing by \(3\) gives the unique solution \(\boxed{x=\frac53}\), choice B.
